name: openstack
description: Poteto's rigorous engineering stack adapted for OpenCode. 52 skills, 23 playbooks, 23 principles, and subagents.

poteto-agent.description: Rigorous engineering subagent that builds verified, minimal-diff solutions

comment-sicko.description: Comment-elimination reviewer that strips unnecessary comments and flags MUST KILL targets

poteto-mode.description: Engage rigorous engineering workflow across 23 playbooks
poteto-mode.template: Read and execute skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md for task: $ARGUMENTS

architect.description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before writing code

arena.description: Spawn parallel candidate solutions, pick a base, and graft the strongest elements

swarm.description: Fan out parallel workers, aggregate results, and return a consolidated report

interrogate.description: Run an adversarial multi-perspective review on code changes

deslop.description: Remove AI-generated code slop, excessive defensive checks, and unearned abstractions

control-cli.description: Build or adapt a local harness to drive, inspect, and profile an interactive CLI or TUI

control-ui.description: Build or adapt a local browser or CDP harness to drive and inspect a web or desktop UI

babysit.description: Drive a pull request or stack of PRs to merge-ready

no-comments.description: Strip unnecessary comments and identify MUST KILL refactor targets using Comment Sicko

setup-openstack.description: Configure model assignments and execution scope for openstack roles in OpenCode

show-me-your-work.description: Maintain a reviewable TSV decision log for long-running tasks
